column3: seat, honour, washing of the feet (offerings of hospitality)
hospitality: seat, honour, foot washing, betel, rest, fanning, scents and garlands
the one who rests on the causal waters (Vishnu)
steady in the battle? (Gavishtha, a name)
by the bearer of the Gandiva bow (Arjuna)
roaming the earth, free of desire
they sing the deeds of the one of excellent fame
of the bearers of the fame of Gudakesha
quality, the state of being a quality
by moods of the qualities, in beings, subtle senses and the self
of the one made of qualities
by those who depend on qualities
of the one whose qualities are matchless
of the mistress of the house
one who has taken the essence and gone
of one who takes age after age
incarnation that removes the distress of cows, brahmanas and gods
dusk (the time when cattle come home)
by wicked cowherds, like a helpless woman
in the form of a cow
the nectar of Govinda's lotus feet
the state of being a pot
like a pot in the sky
in the form of a whirlwind
the foot, a smoke-fire of evil intentions
by the wheel of day and night
(they) did for the sake of nectar
by the stroke of the foot
taking shelter at the lotus feet
and the fires according to rule
and for the meditation of those devoted to none else
with beautiful long eyes, a prominent nose and matched ears
and to the one who serves
broken arms, trees and mountains of many colours (elephant damage)
inside the tips of the colourful flags
and thus it should be understood
and they cite this old story
of the moving and the unmoving
by the play of the Soul of the world
in the story of Jada Bharata
burning of the house of lac
the end of the sins of the people
whose pride grows with birth, power, learning and wealth
for the sake of and so on
dwellers of water, land and sky
whose devotion to Govinda is born
never leaves the heart through calls
of one who wishes to live
one who has inquired into the reality of the Self
one who has conquered the breath
Arjuna, wishing to see his kinsmen
the chapter named the way of the soul (thirty-first)
by the state of being a soul
serves him who does not wish
with the wish to give up (kill) kinsmen
having known the final good of the Self
together with knowledge, detachment and devotion
of the thing to be known
with lotuses and lilies stirred by the leaping of schools of fish
tug-of-war, pulling this way and that
on the vaccination? (on the tika); mark on forehead
of the Lord (of the idol; of the master)
he made the sage one with it and offered
beautiful to see by its splendour
I crossed uncrossable beings? (I crossed the unfathomable)
of those whose minds are set on wealth and desire
knowers of the truth, the truth
that of those whose minds are on nothing else
determination of the group of principles
there the holder of the Rigveda
there equal to a crore of years
by hearing, reflecting, chanting, worshipping and remembering him
I am (the servant) of the Lord
then with eyes full of tears she wept
then, with the mind unawakened by day
